items.title: Claude Opus 4.6 Launches with 'Agent Teams' — Parallel Multi-Agent Coding
items.summary: Anthropic releases Opus 4.6 with 1M token context window and 'agent teams' that split large tasks across coordinated parallel agents. Available in research preview for API users and subscribers.
items.relevance: You're running on this model now. Agent teams could parallelize AVA codebase reviews and ESP32-C6 firmware tasks — multiple agents owning different pieces simultaneously

items.title: OpenAI Fires Back with GPT-5.3-Codex — 25% Faster, Self-Improving
items.summary: OpenAI launches GPT-5.3-Codex minutes after Anthropic's Opus 4.6, claiming it can build 'complex games and apps from scratch over days.' First model that helped debug and deploy itself.
items.relevance: AI coding arms race intensifying — both companies dropped models within 15 minutes of each other. Competition drives better tools for AVA development

items.title: Goldman Sachs Deploys Claude Opus 4.6 Agents for Trade Accounting
items.summary: After 6 months of development, Goldman Sachs is deploying autonomous Claude-powered agents for trade accounting, compliance, and client onboarding — core banking operations.
items.relevance: Shows Claude handling complex, regulated industry workflows autonomously. Same AI powering your development is now running Goldman Sachs operations

items.title: FDA Approves Medtronic Simplera Sync CGM for MiniMed 780G System
items.summary: FDA clears Simplera Sync — an all-in-one disposable CGM with no fingersticks, no overtape, and 2-step insertion — for use with MiniMed 780G automated insulin delivery system.
items.relevance: Simplified CGM insertion is huge for kids like Kaislyn. MiniMed 780G's auto-correction every 5 minutes + meal detection aligns with what AVA's simulation teaches

items.title: Study: isCGM Cuts Hypoglycemia Episodes 45.8% in T1D Over 2 Years
items.summary: New research shows intermittently scanned CGMs reduce hypoglycemia unawareness by 45.8%, lower glucose variability, and decrease hypoglycemia-related fear — while being more cost-effective than rtCGM.
items.relevance: Strong validation for AVA's education mission — even basic scan-style CGMs significantly improve outcomes. Educational content on recognizing lows is critical

items.title: Insulin Pump Market Projected to Hit $18.9B by 2035 — 9.65% CAGR
items.summary: Market analysis shows insulin pump sector growing from $8.26B to $18.93B by 2035. Insulet leads with $2.1B revenue, 500K+ US users. Canada hits 47.8% adoption via government funding.
items.relevance: Massive growing market for diabetes tech — AVA ecosystem sits right in the education layer feeding into this adoption wave. Canada's government-funded model is interesting

items.title: Anthropic's 'SaaSpocalypse' Deepens — Opus 4.6 Triggers Second Wave Selloff
items.summary: Fortune reports Opus 4.6's financial analysis capabilities spooked investors further after Cowork plugins caused initial $285B rout. Model excels at screening, due diligence, and market intelligence.
items.relevance: Claude is reshaping entire industries in real-time. The AI you use daily for coding is simultaneously disrupting Wall Street — speaks to the power of the platform you're building on

items.title: Research: Insulin Pumps Don't Cause Weight Gain in Diabetics — Myth Busted
items.summary: Birmingham Children's Hospital study debunks the common myth that automated insulin pumps contribute to weight gain in diabetes patients, removing a key barrier to pump adoption.
items.relevance: Important myth-busting for AVA educational content — pumps get unfairly stigmatized. Could be a good topic for an in-app learning module on pump therapy facts

items.title: GitHub Integrates Claude and Codex as Coding Agents in Public Preview
items.summary: Claude by Anthropic and OpenAI Codex now available as coding agents for Copilot Pro+ and Enterprise customers, enabling autonomous task assignment from issues and PRs.
items.relevance: Direct integration with your GitHub repos - assign Claude to work on AVA app features autonomously, streamlining development workflow

items.title: Apple Xcode 26.3 Adds Native AI Coding Agent Support
items.summary: Apple releases Xcode 26.3 with autonomous AI coding capabilities, including Claude Agent SDK integration for SwiftUI and UIKit development with visual preview verification.
items.relevance: Game-changer for AVA iOS development - Claude can now autonomously code SwiftUI interfaces, test via Xcode Previews, and iterate without leaving your IDE

items.title: Anthropic Claude Cowork Triggers 'SaaSpocalypse' with Legal Plugin
items.summary: Claude Cowork's 11 new plugins cause $285B tech selloff as AI moves from assistance to automation. Legal, finance, and productivity plugins threaten traditional SaaS models.
items.relevance: Major AI capability expansion - Claude now handles complete workflows from legal to finance. Consider how specialized diabetes education plugins could enhance AVA ecosystem

items.title: Twiist Pump Adds Diabeloop DBLG2 - First No-Meal-Announcement AID System
items.summary: Sequel Med Tech announces partnership with Diabeloop for fully automated insulin delivery algorithm that requires zero meal announcements, launching spring 2026.
items.relevance: Revolutionary simplification of diabetes management - validates AVA's education mission toward fully automated systems. Kids need to understand the underlying physiology as systems get smarter

items.title: OpenAI GPT-5.2 Performance Upgrade - 40% Speed Improvement
items.summary: OpenAI releases GPT-5.2 API upgrade with 40% performance improvement, competing directly with Claude 3.5 Sonnet inference speeds for coding tasks.
items.relevance: AI competition intensifying - validates your Claude Code choice as both companies push performance boundaries. Expect continued improvements in coding assistance quality

items.title: Medtronic MiniMed Go FDA Cleared - Smart MDI with Libre Integration
items.summary: Medtronic's MiniMed Go mobile app receives FDA clearance, pairing InPen smart insulin pen with rebranded Libre 3 Plus (Instinct) for advanced MDI management.
items.relevance: Smart MDI systems advancing - good reference for AVA app's insulin-on-board modeling and carb ratio education. Shows market demand for intelligent diabetes management tools

items.title: DexCom CEO: GLP-1 Users Should Also Wear CGMs
items.summary: DexCom CEO Jake Leach advocates for CGM use among type 2 diabetics on GLP-1 medications, expanding CGM market beyond traditional insulin-dependent users.
items.relevance: CGM market expanding beyond T1D - potential broader audience for AVA educational content. Consider educational modules for T2D and GLP-1 users understanding glucose patterns

items.title: 2026 SaaS Trends: AI Investment Without Performance Visibility
items.summary: Zylo's SaaS Management Index shows teams heavily investing in AI tools but lacking visibility into productivity gains, cost savings, or performance impact measurement.
items.relevance: Important insight for AVA monetization - focus on measurable outcomes and clear ROI when positioning educational tools. Track learning progress and diabetes management improvements
